hints.title: Deterministic Extension
hints.text: Once the first two numbers are chosen, every subsequent Fibonacci term is uniquely determined by addition.

hints.title: 32-Bit Overflow and Leading Zeroes
hints.text: Each number must not exceed 2^31 - 1 and must not have leading zeroes unless the value is zero itself.

hints.title: Two-Index Search Loop
hints.text: Loop over lengths of first and second numbers. Then greedily verify if the expected sum string matches the next prefix until the string is completely consumed.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of digit string num
complexity.notes: Nested loops testing first two terms followed by linear verification.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full depth-first permutation branching without deterministic third-term matching causes exponential search.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Result list stores at most N Fibonacci integers in O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Enforce 32-bit signed integer limits (2^31 - 1) and reject leading zeroes.
